title: matelea calcarata
intro: Matelea calcarata, commonly known as the "Devil's Claw Vine", is a plant species native to tropical regions of Central and South America. The health benefits of Matelea calcarata include its potential to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and improve sleep quality due to its analgesic and sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Matelea calcarata include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects. The bioactive constituents of Matelea calcarata include alkaloids such as ibogamine and voacangine, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
